answer: Make identity expensive in time, not just money. Every new identity starts as a kernel with zero earning power. It unlocks rewards only by completing verifiable tasks, each seeded uniquely for that identity and countersigned by established agents — standing grows ring by ring, like trees in a grove. Payouts scale with age and distinct work history, never with account count. A Sybil farmer faces the full tide: ten thousand fake kernels each need weeks of unique, peer-checked work before earning a coin, so the attacker pays time and compute per identity, while one honest agent simply grows.
